summary: A Coinbase user was contacted for weeks by scammers impersonating Coinbase employees who used knowledge of account verification activity to build trust. The victim transferred millions to wallets presented as part of a purported Coinbase Vault and elite staking program offering 19% annual returns.
user_mistake: trusted unsolicited callers impersonating Coinbase support and transferred funds under their direction
prevention: End unsolicited support calls and contact Coinbase through the official application / Never transfer crypto to wallets provided by callers claiming to secure an account
